main_metrics: average returns, regression slopes, portfolio spreads

limitations_reported_by_authors: Not separately available in the reviewed abstract/metadata; consult full text before relying on this field.

what_the_student_should_understand: Portfolio sorts and regressions answer different questions; publication-era evidence is not a Phase B test.
